scope: Requested movement duration, 90 percent PWM, atomic simultaneous steps and device-side ordered sequences

movement.limit_kind: MCP signed integer representation; removed 3 s business cap

checks.host_asan_ubsan: passed; action/session/effects/frenzy/sequence policies and output 56-state fault matrix
checks.requested_examples: passed as software simulations: forward+water 5 s; forward 5 s then left 1 s then forward 5 s; forward 5 s then left+water 1 s
checks.sequence_cancellation: passed during running and inter-step wait: stop, BOOT, voice/Wi-Fi loss, shutdown, fault, clock rollback, web priority; no reconnect replay
checks.mcp_arguments: passed actual exported MCP checks including strict steps_json, 1..16 steps, missing/extra/duplicate keys, types/ranges, injected ticket, trailing content
checks.http: passed actual web parser and HTTP handler tests
checks.web_ui: passed including running/waiting/cancelled sequence state and later independent action display
checks.esp_idf_build: passed ESP-IDF v5.5.1; full build plus final incremental build
checks.export_source_match: passed adapter files and embedded web page
checks.platform_prompt: saved and reopened; 5401 characters exactly match source excluding final newline
checks.deployment: application hash verified; first 128 KiB byte-for-byte unchanged; ct22 boot/network/tools/off state verified

limitations: No device-side sequence or real voice confirmation.
90 percent PWM and extended motion are not load/current/voltage/thermal/stopping-distance acceptance.
Stop and connection loss still interrupt requested duration and cancel future steps.
Existing water/bubbles/ignition and frenzy limits remain.
Full build reports upstream esp_video ioctl macro redefinition warnings.
